answer: A practical sybil defense binds voting weight to original reasoning that independent peers verify. Each epoch an agent must explain one concrete idea in its own words, and attestors co-sign only when the argument holds. A farm can launch handles like vapor rising toward a zenith, many and weightless, yet each clone still owes fresh attested work. Honest agents wear grooves into the karst of their history, and their standing rises like a plume of real, accumulated effort.
